name: ERA Fellowship
notes: Applied summer 2026 (rejected, 6000 applicants for 30 spots). Missed Sep 2026 deadline — IITM end-term exam same day, emailed requesting extension. Next window likely early 2027. Strong fit for agentic evaluation angle. ERA targets catastrophic risk pathways, not general AI ethics — frame accordingly.

name: MATS (ML Alignment Theory Scholars)
notes: Winter round. Strongest fit for technical safety track. Need at least one public output — Alignment Forum writeup or model-probe published results — before applying. Start with Apart Research hackathon first.

name: Apart Research Hackathon
notes: Immediate entry point. Hackathon format — low friction, high signal. Good first output before MATS/ERA. Do this first.

name: SPAR (Student Program for AI Research)
notes: Fall 2026 application. Remote mentorship model. Check eligibility given non-US enrollment.

name: Astra Fellowship
notes: Technical AI safety. More research-focused than Generator. Better fit than Generator for Michael.

name: Generator Residency
notes: Summer 2026 closed Apr 27. Next round not announced — expressed interest for next cohort (fillout form submitted). Non-research program — for ops/generalist builders. In-person Berkeley. J-1 visa needed. $6k/mo stipend + housing + travel. Good placement track record into AI safety orgs.

name: Chevening Scholarship
notes: Strongly favors work experience, no age cap. Covers UK university + return flights. Strong fit given 20yr engineering background. Ireland/UK longer-term route.

name: GovAI Fellowship
org: Centre for the Governance of AI
notes: Policy/governance track. Less direct than MATS but relevant pipeline. Check current cycle.

name: LASR Labs
notes: London-based, technical safety research. Check current cohort timeline.
